name: Clueso MCP
description: Lets AI agents create and edit product videos, motion graphics, and step-by-step docs in a Clueso workspace through a remote OAuth MCP server, with outputs that stay editable.

skills.name: Video Project Editing
skills.description: Creates, duplicates, and exports video projects, and adds, splits, and updates clips and elements with tools like create_project and add_clips.

skills.name: Voiceover And Audio
skills.description: Generates narration with voiceover_batch and set_voice, adds background audio, and syncs visuals to speech with auto_sync.

skills.name: Clueprint Templates
skills.description: Finds, reads, and creates reusable clueprint templates with pre-designed clip layouts and voiceover patterns to build videos from.

skills.name: Help Article Editing
skills.description: Reads and updates step-by-step documentation articles and their media with get_article, update_article, and add_article_media.
